problem_statement:
pruneDumps fails the whole prune when an R2 bucket lock refuses one delete

With an R2 bucket lock rule on the dump prefix, R2 refuses to delete any object younger than the rule's age (error 10069, `ObjectLockedByBucketPolicy`; the Workers binding throws an error whose `code` is 10069 and whose message ends with "(10069)"). `pruneDumps` deletes every stale key in one chunked call, so a single locked key throws out of the prune: none of the other stale runs is deleted and the nightly job fails. Young stale runs (e.g. a same-day duplicate run) are exactly the ones a lock will refuse.

Reproduce: wrap a bucket so `delete` throws `Object.assign(new Error("... (10069)"), { code: 10069 })` for keys of a recent stale run, then call `pruneDumps(bucket, { now })` with older stale runs also present. It throws and nothing is pruned.

Expected:
- A stale run whose delete is refused by a bucket lock is skipped and the prune carries on with the other stale runs. A later prune picks it up again once the lock has aged off.
- `PruneResult` reports it: `{ kept, pruned, locked }`, where `locked` counts runs left in place because of a lock (always present, `0` normally); `pruned` counts only runs actually deleted.
- A run should never be left looking complete after a partial delete: delete its `_complete.json` marker first, in its own call, then the rest of its objects.
- Any other delete failure (not a lock refusal) still throws.
fail_to_pass: npx vitest run test/runs.test.ts -t "bucket lock refuses"
npx vitest run test/runs.test.ts -t "marker before its tables"
npx vitest run test/runs.test.ts -t "flat prune keeps a run inside retention even past the floor"
pass_to_pass: npx vitest run test/runs.test.ts -t "still throws on a delete failure"
npx vitest run test/runs.test.ts -t "selectStaleRuns is the rule"
